name: CryptAPI
line: No-signup crypto payment API that forwards funds to your wallet.

free.text: No setup or monthly fee; 1% at the lowest volume tier

cells.countries: Marketed globally; full seller-country list unpublished
cells.payout: Forwards after the configured network confirmations

fee.math: One published rate list applies worldwide: 1% for sellers under $250,000 in volume over the past 30 days. The full list of seller countries isn't published.
